name: Andromeda Galaxy
description: Our nearest galactic neighbor and the most distant object visible to the naked eye.

name: Orion Nebula
description: A bright stellar nursery visible to the naked eye as the middle 'star' in Orion's sword.

name: Pleiades
description: The Seven Sisters. A stunning blue reflection nebula and cluster.

name: Hercules Cluster
description: A massive ball of several hundred thousand stars.

name: Whirlpool Galaxy
description: A classic spiral galaxy interacting with a smaller companion galaxy.

name: Ring Nebula
description: The glowing remains of a sun-like star that shed its outer layers.

name: Crab Nebula
description: The remnant of a massive star explosion observed by Chinese astronomers in 1054 AD.

name: Lagoon Nebula
description: A giant interstellar cloud in the constellation Sagittarius.

name: Sombrero Galaxy
description: A spiral galaxy seen edge-on with a prominent dust lane resembling a hat.

name: Eagle Nebula
description: Famous for the 'Pillars of Creation' photographed by Hubble.

name: Dumbbell Nebula
description: The first planetary nebula to be discovered.

name: Triangulum Galaxy
description: The third-largest member of our Local Group of galaxies.

name: Beehive Cluster
description: One of the nearest open clusters to Earth.

name: Bode's Galaxy
description: A grand design spiral galaxy near the Big Dipper.

name: Cigar Galaxy
description: A starburst galaxy appearing edge-on near Bode's Galaxy.

name: Wild Duck Cluster
description: One of the richest and most compact open clusters.

name: Butterfly Cluster
description: A bright cluster that resembles the shape of a butterfly.

name: Ptolemy's Cluster
description: A large cluster visible to the naked eye near the stinger of the Scorpion.

name: Omega Centauri
description: The largest globular cluster in the Milky Way
